name: Avatares AI - Register Raw Asset Batch - Callable

parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO canonical_asset_registry (
      asset_id,
      sha256,
      avatar,
      asset_type,
      scene,
      version,
      workflow,
      model,
      seed,
      bucket,
      object_path,
      original_filename,
      mime_type,
      file_size,
      extension,
      prompt,
      negative_prompt,
      sampler,
      steps,
      cfg,
      tags,
      metadata,
      status,
      review_notes,
      is_canonical,
      canonical_group
  )
  VALUES (
      '{{ $json.assetId }}',
      '{{ $json.sha256 }}',
      '{{ $json.avatar }}',
      '{{ $json.assetType }}',
      '{{ $json.scene }}',
      {{ $json.version }},
      '{{ $json.workflow }}',
      '{{ $json.model }}',
      {{ $json.seed }},
      '{{ $json.storage.bucket }}',
      '{{ $json.objectPath }}',
      '{{ $json.file.name }}',
      '{{ $json.file.mimeType }}',
      {{ $json.file.size }},
      '{{ $json.file.extension }}',
      '{{ $json.generation.prompt }}',
      '{{ $json.generation.negativePrompt }}',
      '{{ $json.generation.sampler }}',
      NULL,
      NULL,
      '{{ JSON.stringify($json.tags) }}'::jsonb,
      '{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}'::jsonb,
      'raw',
      NULL,
      false,
      '{{ $json.canonicalGroup }}'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (sha256)
  DO NOTHING
  RETURNING
      asset_id,
      sha256,
      avatar,
      asset_type,
      scene,
      asset_type AS asset_type_returned,
      object_path,
      status,
      canonical_group
)
SELECT * FROM inserted;
